concerns.text: T010 (Compute Pilot Correlation) depends on automated metrics (entropy, variance, object count) which are produced by T019 in Phase 4. The task list places T010 in Phase 3 (US0) before T019 (US1) is executed. This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule; the pilot correlation cannot be computed without the metrics generated in Phase 4. T010 must be moved to Phase 5 or depend explicitly on T019.

T011 (Pilot Interface) and T011a_real (Recruitment Manager) are marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, T011 (collecting ratings) logically requires the cohort metadata generated by T011a_real to link participants to sessions. T011 cannot function independently if T011a_real has not run. This is a hidden shared-state dependency making the [P] tag incorrect.

T029 (Session Server) consumes the counterbalanced order generated by T027. While T027 is listed in Phase 6, T029 does not explicitly declare a dependency on T027. If T029 runs before T027, it will fail to load the counterbalance order. The task order implies T027 must precede T029, but the dependency is not enforced in the task list structure.

T041 (Sensitivity Analysis Sweep) produces the stability conclusion, but the calculation of the standard deviation of effect sizes (required for SC-005 and FR-005b) is delegated to T080. T041 does not depend on T080, and T080 is listed separately. This creates a risk that T041 generates a conclusion without the necessary SD metric being computed first. T041 must depend on T080 or T080 must be integrated into T041.

T028 (Baseline Task Handler) depends on T032d (Curate Neutral Stimuli) which is in Phase 2. However, T028 is in Phase 6. The task list correctly places the dependency, but T029 (Session Server) which loads the counterbalance order (T027) and presents clips (T032) does not explicitly depend on T032 (Fetch Real Meeting Clips) or T032c (Curate Meeting Backgrounds). The server cannot present clips if they haven't been fetched and curated.
